test_BITAND: test the SQL BITAND and BIT_AND functions for bitwise AND operations on DataFrame columns
test_BITCOUNT: test the SQL BITCOUNT and BIT_COUNT functions for counting set bits in DataFrame column values
test_BITNOT: test the SQL BITNOT and BIT_NOT functions for bitwise NOT operations on DataFrame column values
test_BITOR: test the SQL BITOR and BIT_OR functions for bitwise OR operations on DataFrame columns
test_BITXOR: test the SQL BITXOR and BIT_XOR functions for bitwise XOR operations on DataFrame columns
